improvements.reason: A repeat publishes a distinct immutable generation with 201 instead of reproducing the recorded 500. Full injected UUID entropy prevents deterministic-prefix collisions; failed storage never creates successful metadata.
An identical current assertion returns an explicit 409; later changed evidence and lifecycle transitions still append durable history.
An unknown engagement scope is a caller error and returns JSON detail with 422, not an unhandled Python enum-conversion 500.
Formula-like authored text remains an inline string instead of executable spreadsheet content. A focused integration test injects =1+1 and proves literal provenance text with no formula elements.
Successful creation exposes an API-relative download Location, as required by the task, without adding storage paths or credentials to the JSON contract.
Registered bytes are checked against both stored size and SHA-256 before streaming. Corruption produces an audited missing outcome and safe 503 rather than serving bytes that contradict the metadata.
